about_the_game:
The Tournament Begins Here!

Get ready for epic battles where food comes to life, armed with grappling hooks and brutal abilities. In a universe where food means power, survival is all about skill and strategy. Play, fight, and prove who will dominate the “Gastronomic Tournament”!

Dynamic and Competitive Gameplay

Step into the shoes of living foods and join intense multiplayer battles with up to 4 players simultaneously. Each round is a race to eliminate your opponents and be the last food standing!

  • Use the Grappling Hook: Pull enemies, reach strategic spots, or dodge deadly traps.

  • Master Melee Combat: Finish opponents with deadly precision.

  • Stay Agile: Dash, dodge, and outmaneuver rivals in a fast-paced and competitive rhythm.

With creative maps and characters full of personality, every match delivers a fresh and electrifying experience.

The Future of the Project

For the future of the project, we’re counting on the support of indie game enthusiasts and parry game fans. Our goal is to build an increasingly complete and fun experience, evolving the game collaboratively.

Planned improvements include:

  • Interface enhancements, making navigation clearer and more intuitive;

  • New battle arenas, each with unique challenges and traps;

  • Bot mode, to train and have fun even when playing solo;

  • Advanced customization options, such as enabling or disabling traps and adjusting environment interactions;

  • Online multiplayer, allowing you to face friends and players around the world.

Beyond these additions, we want to listen to community feedback every step of the way. With this constant exchange, we’ll not only deliver new features but also refine the balance and flow of matches, ensuring every session is intense, strategic, and unforgettable.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.5GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 550 or equivalent
  • Storage: 240 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 650 or equivalent
  • Storage: 240 MB available space

short_description: A chaotic, action-packed parry game to play with friends and family! Choose your favorite food, master the grappling hook, dodge crazy traps, and survive electrifying arenas. Have fun and prove who’s the true champion!
supported_languages: Portuguese - Brazil, English, Spanish - Latin America
